title: Expose and verify the default powerful working cloud brain end to end
goal: Expose actual primary brain model, capability evidence, working-state freshness, exclusions and fallback/recovery events through existing brain/status/mission diagnostics with no secrets. Add end-to-end hermetic coverage through production intent, planning, parallel execution and self-improvement entry points proving the strongest authorized working cloud model leads by default, even when a cheaper/local model is configured; a stronger nonworking candidate is excluded. Verify explicit pins, free-only/privacy/budget restrictions, no eligible cloud model, safe fallback and return after recovery. Include deterministic release E2E coverage where practical; do not report policy activation merely from configuration or catalog presence. Implement nonzero tests named powerful_cloud_brain_e2e_* exercising production behavior.
